title: A股港股早报：激光雷达与锂电映射升温，油价利率压估值 + 美股盘前：非农前夕风险降温，AI基础设施强于高估值软件
summary: 隔夜美股指数小跌但结构分化，Futunn Sparks 显示激光雷达、锂矿、太空和外卖领涨；A/H 早盘重点看舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链的价格确认，油价与长债上行仍压制估值。

entries.label: 美股盘前
entries.title: 美股盘前：非农前夕风险降温，AI基础设施强于高估值软件
entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
宏观
美股周四小幅回落，非农前风险偏好降温
8月6日道指跌0.85%，标普500跌0.18%，纳指跌0.06%，Russell 2000跌0.6%；三大指数仍保留周内涨幅，但盘面从指数上涨转向财报筛选。
能源
霍尔木兹与伊朗相关不确定性推高油价
布伦特和WTI继续受地缘风险溢价支撑，油价上涨同时推升通胀担忧，是压制估值和道指周期股的核心变量。
利率
10年期美债收益率升至约4.64%区域
油价上涨和就业数据前的仓位调整使长端利率上行，高久期软件和半导体估值承压。
就业
7月非农将在周五公布，市场预期新增约8.8万人
失业率预期约4.2%；若就业过强，降息预期可能再被压缩，若就业明显走弱，则盈利韧性会成为新的担忧。
软件
软件股出现“高预期惩罚”，HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin承压
HubSpot下调全年收入指引，Datadog虽超预期但被质疑增速斜率，AppLovin也因收入和指引问题拖累软件情绪。
财报
Cloudflare财报后强涨，成为软件板块少数正反馈
NET二季度收入和EPS均高于预期，并上调全年收入与利润指引，盘后涨幅约15%-16%，价格反馈明显优于同业。
财报
Unity财报后反弹，验证游戏引擎和广告业务修复
U在业绩和展望后出现两位数涨幅，是软件抛售中少见的强反馈标的，适合用价格确认而非情绪追高。
芯片
存储链仍分化，Western Digital和SanDisk此前因指引受罚
市场对存储公司不再只看收入和EPS beat，而更看库存、价格周期和后续指引，半导体内部轮动从普涨转向设备和AI龙头。
AI
Microsoft与Nvidia相对强势，AI权重仍是指数稳定器
MSFT周四逆势上行并突破买点区域，NVDA在AI链中保持相对强势，说明资金仍愿意持有现金流更确定的AI核心资产。
日历
8月7日科技财报样本集中在盘前，盘后大型科技样本不足
Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) 确认为8月7日盘前/早间披露，不属于盘后beat概率样本；Nasdaq、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger和StoxPulse未给出可验证的大型科技盘后样本。

盘前结论

今天开盘前的主线不是单纯看指数，而是看“非农前利率定价 + 财报价格反馈”。周四指数跌幅不深，但油价、10年期美债和软件股抛售同时出现，说明风险偏好已经从追高转向确认盈利质量。

科技内部继续分化：Cloudflare、Unity、Teradyne这类财报后被资金直接买入的公司可以放在强势观察池；HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin这类“数字不差但预期更高”的公司，应先看止跌和成交修复，不适合在负反馈阶段追多。

开盘后的大盘更可能是震荡偏谨慎：若非农前收益率继续上行，Nasdaq会受估值压制；若油价回落且软件抛售没有扩散到AI权重，标普和纳指仍有机会靠NET、MSFT、NVDA等强反馈标的托住。

重点个股推荐

Cloudflare
NET
强势跟踪

推荐理由：二季度收入、EPS和全年指引均高于预期，盘后涨幅约15%-16%，是软件板块负反馈中最清晰的正反馈。

触发因素：开盘后若能守住盘后涨幅的一半以上，并且成交继续放大，可确认AI网络基础设施叙事被资金接受。

风险点：估值已经包含较高增长预期，若长债收益率继续上行或软件ETF继续走弱，容易出现高开回落。

Unity Software
U
修复观察

推荐理由：业绩和展望后出现两位数上涨，说明市场愿意奖励广告和游戏引擎业务改善，价格反馈强于多数软件股。

触发因素：若开盘后仍强于IGV和ARKK，且回踩不破盘后核心区间，可作为高弹性软件修复样本。

风险点：公司历史波动大，若软件抛售扩散，短线资金可能快速兑现。

Microsoft
MSFT
核心配置

推荐理由：周四逆势上涨并保持AI权重股相对强势，现金流和云业务确定性使其比高估值中小软件更抗利率波动。

触发因素：若非农前10Y不继续快速上冲，MSFT有望继续承担指数稳定器角色。

风险点：若AI资本开支质疑升温或大盘进入系统性去风险，权重股也会被动承压。

Teradyne
TER
设备链强势

推荐理由：盘后报价显示TER涨幅约13%，强于存储链和多数半导体同业，体现资金向测试设备和AI硬件配套方向切换。

触发因素：若开盘后相对SOXX继续走强，可作为半导体内部轮动的确认样本。

风险点：单一盘后报价流动性有限，若SOXX整体转弱，设备链强势可能被指数拖累。

板块轮动看板

强势观察AI基础设施、网络安全、半导体测试设备、现金流确定的大型AI权重。
事件驱动NET、U、TER等财报后强价格反馈；TTWO为盘前披露，只做财报事件观察。
压力方向HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin代表的软件高预期交易，存储链继续受指引和周期质疑压制。
验证信号开盘后看10Y是否突破4.65%上方、油价是否继续上行、IGV能否止跌以及NET/U高开后是否承接。

逻辑链

宏观约束

油价和10Y上行使市场在非农前降低估值容忍度。

财报筛选

同样是beat，资金只奖励能上调指引且价格确认的公司。

科技分层

AI核心和基础设施强于高估值软件，存储链需要等待指引风险消化。

开盘策略

优先跟踪强反馈延续，弱反馈标的只做止跌验证，不抢反弹。

盘后财报 beat 概率

可验证盘后科技财报公司不足/无大型科技公司。已检查 Nasdaq earnings calendar、MarketBeat、Investing.com、Kiplinger 和 StoxPulse：8月7日最明确的科技样本是 Take-Two Interactive (TTWO)，但其披露时间为盘前/早间，不属于盘后即将披露样本。

高概率无可验证盘后科技公司样本，因此不做高概率分层。
中概率无可验证盘后科技公司样本；若后续出现临时确认公司，需要重新核对一致预期、历史surprise和盘前价格。
补充观察TTWO为盘前事件，历史上有beat记录且游戏发布周期改善，但不纳入盘后beat概率判断。

风险雷达

非农强于预期可能推高10Y，压制Nasdaq和软件估值。

油价继续上涨会重新抬升通胀交易，拖累风险资产广度。

NET、U、TER若高开低走，说明财报强反馈被大盘流动性吞噬。

HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin的弱势若扩散到更多软件龙头，IGV可能继续承压。

数据来源与时间点

来源：AP、WSJ、MarketWatch、Barron's、Investor's Business Daily、Investing.com after-hours、Nasdaq/MarketBeat/Kiplinger/StoxPulse earnings calendars；抓取时间：2026-08-07 05:24 CST。浏览器/部分实时盘前深度数据不可用，已按规则使用公开报价和新闻源降级继续。
entries.html_en:
Major News Summary
Macro
US stocks slipped Thursday as risk appetite cooled before payrolls
On August 6, the Dow fell 0.85%, the S&P 500 lost 0.18%, the Nasdaq slipped 0.06%, and the Russell 2000 fell 0.6%; weekly gains remain, but the tape shifted from index momentum to earnings selection.
Energy
Hormuz and Iran uncertainty kept an oil risk premium in place
Brent and WTI remained supported by geopolitical risk. Higher oil also lifted inflation concerns, making it the key variable pressuring valuations and Dow cyclicals.
Rates
The US 10-year yield moved toward the 4.64% area
Higher oil prices and positioning ahead of jobs data pushed long yields higher, weighing on long-duration software and semiconductor valuations.
Jobs
July payrolls are due Friday, with consensus near 88,000 jobs
The unemployment rate is expected near 4.2%; a strong print could further compress easing expectations, while a weak print would shift concern toward earnings durability.
Software
Software saw a high-expectation penalty, with HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin under pressure
HubSpot cut full-year revenue guidance, Datadog beat but was questioned on growth slope, and AppLovin added pressure through revenue and guidance concerns.
Earnings
Cloudflare rallied after earnings, standing out as rare positive software feedback
NET beat second-quarter revenue and EPS expectations and raised full-year revenue and profit guidance; after-hours gains near 15%-16% were far stronger than peers.
Earnings
Unity rebounded after results, validating game-engine and advertising recovery
U posted a double-digit move after earnings and outlook, making it one of the few strong-feedback software names during the broader selloff.
Chips
Memory remained split after Western Digital and SanDisk were punished for guidance
Investors are no longer rewarding memory companies solely for revenue and EPS beats; inventory, pricing cycle, and forward guidance now matter more.
AI
Microsoft and Nvidia showed relative strength as AI weights stabilized the index
MSFT rose against the tape and moved through a buy area, while NVDA remained relatively strong inside the AI chain, showing continued demand for clearer cash-flow AI exposure.
Calendar
August 7 technology earnings are concentrated before the open, with no large after-close sample verified
Take-Two Interactive (TTWO) is confirmed for August 7 before market/early morning reporting, so it is not an after-close beat-probability sample; Nasdaq, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, and StoxPulse did not show a verifiable large-cap technology after-close sample.

Premarket View

The setup before the open is not simply about index direction; it is about “payrolls-driven rate repricing plus earnings price feedback.” Thursday's index losses were shallow, but oil, the 10-year yield, and software selling rose together, showing that risk appetite has moved from chasing strength to verifying earnings quality.

Technology remains split. Cloudflare, Unity, and Teradyne, which were bought directly after earnings, belong in the strength watchlist. HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin, where the numbers were not enough for stretched expectations, should first prove stabilization and volume repair.

The open is more likely to be cautious and range-bound. If yields keep rising before payrolls, Nasdaq should face valuation pressure; if oil eases and software selling does not spread into AI megacaps, the S&P 500 and Nasdaq can still be supported by NET, MSFT, and NVDA.

BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not price change.

Key Stock Picks

Cloudflare
NET
Strength follow

Reason: second-quarter revenue, EPS, and full-year guidance all beat expectations, and the roughly 15%-16% after-hours gain is the clearest positive feedback in software.

Trigger: if the stock keeps at least half of the after-hours gain after the open and volume expands, the AI network-infrastructure thesis is being accepted by buyers.

Risk: valuation already prices in high growth, so higher long yields or continued software ETF weakness could trigger a fade.

Unity Software
U
Recovery watch

Reason: the double-digit move after earnings and outlook shows investors are willing to reward improvement in ads and game-engine activity.

Trigger: if U stays stronger than IGV and ARKK after the open and holds the core after-hours range, it can serve as a high-beta software recovery sample.

Risk: the stock is historically volatile, and quick profit-taking is likely if software selling broadens.

Microsoft
MSFT
Core holding

Reason: MSFT rose against the tape and remained strong among AI weights; cash flow and cloud visibility make it more resilient than high-valuation mid-cap software.

Trigger: if the 10-year yield does not keep surging before payrolls, MSFT can continue acting as an index stabilizer.

Risk: if AI capex skepticism rises or the market moves into broad de-risking, mega-cap weights will also face passive selling.

Teradyne
TER
Equipment strength

Reason: after-hours quotes showed TER up about 13%, stronger than memory names and most semiconductor peers, pointing to rotation toward test equipment and AI hardware support.

Trigger: if TER remains stronger than SOXX after the open, it can confirm semiconductor rotation inside the group.

Risk: a single after-hours quote has limited liquidity, and broad SOXX weakness can still drag equipment names lower.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength WatchAI infrastructure, cybersecurity, semiconductor test equipment, and cash-flow-backed AI megacaps.
Event DrivenNET, U, and TER after strong post-earnings price feedback; TTWO reports before the open and is only an earnings-event watch.
Pressure AreasHigh-expectation software represented by HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin, while memory remains pressured by guidance and cycle concerns.
Validation SignalsWatch whether the 10-year breaks above 4.65%, oil keeps rising, IGV stabilizes, and NET/U hold gains after the open.

Logic Chain

Macro constraint

Higher oil and the 10-year yield lowered the market's tolerance for valuation risk before payrolls.

Earnings filter

Even with beats, buyers are rewarding only companies that raise guidance and confirm through price action.

Technology tiers

AI core and infrastructure are stronger than high-valuation software, while memory needs more time to digest guidance risk.

Opening strategy

Track strong feedback first; for weak-feedback names, wait for stabilization instead of buying the first dip.

After-Close Earnings Beat Probability

Verifiable after-close technology earnings samples are insufficient / no large technology company sample is available. Nasdaq earnings calendar, MarketBeat, Investing.com, Kiplinger, and StoxPulse were checked: the clearest August 7 technology sample is Take-Two Interactive (TTWO), but it reports before the open/early morning and is not an after-close sample.

High probabilityNo verifiable after-close technology company sample, so no high-probability tier is assigned.
Medium probabilityNo verifiable after-close technology company sample; if a late-confirmed company appears, consensus, historical surprise, and premarket price must be rechecked.
Supplemental watchTTWO is a before-open event with historical beat evidence and an improving game-release cycle, but it is not included in after-close beat probability.

Risk Radar

A stronger-than-expected payrolls print could lift the 10-year yield and pressure Nasdaq and software valuations.

Further oil gains would revive the inflation trade and weaken risk-asset breadth.

If NET, U, and TER open strong but fade, earnings strength is being overwhelmed by market liquidity.

If weakness in HubSpot, Datadog, and AppLovin spreads to more software leaders, IGV may remain under pressure.

Sources and Timestamp

Sources: AP, WSJ, MarketWatch, Barron's, Investor's Business Daily, Investing.com after-hours, Nasdaq/MarketBeat/Kiplinger/StoxPulse earnings calendars; retrieval time: 2026-08-07 05:24 CST. Browser and some real-time premarket depth data were unavailable, so public quotes and news sources were used under the degrade-and-continue rule.

entries.html:
重大新闻汇总
国际
霍尔木兹不确定性继续推升油价，A/H 能源安全与航运链获得事件溢价
隔夜美股下跌的核心约束来自油价和美债收益率同步上行；中东/伊朗相关谈判与通航安排仍未形成稳定预期，A股油气、油服、航运和通胀受益链可能获得防御资金，但高油价会压制航空、化工中下游和高估值成长。
宏观
美国非农公布前长债收益率上行，港股成长股估值弹性受限
公开行情显示8月6日道指跌0.85%、标普500跌0.18%、纳指跌0.06%，10年期美债收益率升至约4.67%区域；若今晚非农偏强，港股互联网和A股高估值科技的反弹空间会先受利率约束。
科技
Futunn Sparks 隔夜最强链条是激光雷达、锂矿、太空与外卖
Sparks 正收益前五为激光雷达概念 +4.92%（AEVA +28.81%）、锂矿概念股 +3.99%（ALB +5.54%）、枪械制造 +3.72%（CDRE +12.86%）、太空概念 +3.44%（BKSY +10.37%）、外卖概念 +3.17%（UBER +3.36%）。A/H 映射重点看智能驾驶传感器、锂资源、低空经济/卫星互联网和美团。
软件
美股软件出现高预期惩罚，A/H 软件与云服务需要先看止跌
HubSpot、Datadog、AppLovin、Figma、Duolingo 等软件股因业绩/指引和 AI 定价担忧遭遇抛售，显示市场不再简单奖励收入 beat；港股金蝶、明源云及 A股信创/软件服务更适合等成交企稳。
半导体
存储与半导体分化，AI PC 和光通信仍有结构性映射
Sandisk、Western Digital 此前因指引承压，说明存储链交易进入“价格和库存验证”阶段；但 Sparks 中 AI PC、光通信、人脸识别仍有正收益行，A股 CPO、光模块、消费电子零部件可看相对强弱，不宜无差别追芯片。
中概
热门中概微涨但内部宽度不足，平台股靠个股催化而非指数共振
Sparks 热门中概股 +0.59%，ZLAB +13.66% 但板块涨跌家数为16/21/0；这意味着港股恒生科技今日更依赖美团、阿里、腾讯各自催化和南向资金承接，而不是单纯跟随中概指数。
财报
可验证 A/H 财报结果不足，Futu OpenD 子检查受限
按规则尝试 HK/SH/SZ 财报日历和 NOTICE 公告搜索，但本机 OpenD 连接 127.0.0.1:11111 被拒绝；未用美股公司财报填充 A/H 财报模块，今日只保留“公告检查受限/财报空窗”的风险提示。
政策
香港离岸人民币产品扩容继续支撑金融基础设施叙事
香港近期推出离岸中国国债期货并强化人民币债券、黄金和流动性安排，有利于交易所、券商和人民币资产配置主题；但短线需看港股保险税务扰动是否继续压制金融权重。
本地
前一交易日 A股偏稳、港股受保险拖累，今日需要科技链接力
Reuters 报道前一交易日内地股市大体持稳、黄金股对冲科技走弱，香港市场受保险股下跌拖累；若今日科技链不能接力，指数更可能维持震荡而非单边上攻。

盘前结论

今天可交易的利多线索较窄但清晰：Sparks 指向激光雷达、锂矿、太空/无人机和外卖映射，而不是科技股全面反弹。舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链需要开盘后用成交量确认。

宏观天花板同样明确：油价上行和 10Y 美债约 4.67% 会降低市场对高估值成长的容忍度。美股软件与存储负反馈意味着 A/H 云软件和泛芯片要先经过价格过滤。

基准判断是 A/H 指数震荡、板块轮动强于指数 beta。若恒生科技强于恒指且南向资金买入平台股，早盘可以略偏积极；否则能源、黄金和金融基础设施主题更容易保持相对强势。

舜宇光学科技
2382.HK
映射观察

推荐理由：激光雷达概念是 Sparks 最强板块，智能驾驶传感器和车载光学链条与公司业务方向相关，适合作为港股硬件映射观察。

触发因素：若开盘后强于恒生科技且成交放大，说明美股激光雷达异动被港股资金承接。

风险点：AEVA 单股涨幅很大但不等于行业订单全面改善，若港股汽车链走弱，映射交易会快速降温。

赣锋锂业
1772.HK / 002460.SZ
资源弹性

推荐理由：锂矿概念股在 Sparks 中排名第二，ALB +5.54% 给锂资源价格和补库预期带来短线映射。

触发因素：港股 1772.HK 与 A股锂矿指数同步放量上行，且碳酸锂期货不再走弱。

风险点：锂价中期供需仍有压力，若 ALB 强势只是财报/个股因素，A/H 锂矿追高容易回落。

美团
3690.HK
平台验证

推荐理由：外卖概念 +3.17%、UBER +3.36%，对本地生活平台情绪有正向映射；美团也是恒生科技权重。

触发因素：若恒生科技早盘反弹且美团领涨平台股，可确认外卖映射与南向资金共同作用。

风险点：港股平台股仍受消费、竞争和估值约束，若中概宽度不足，单一 UBER 映射不宜过度外推。

中无人机
688297.SH
低空经济

推荐理由：太空概念、无人机概念在 Sparks 中靠前，映射 A股低空经济、无人系统和卫星互联网主题。

触发因素：若低空经济 ETF/军工电子板块开盘强于创业板，并有政策或订单催化配合，可做事件观察。

风险点：主题波动大且部分个股估值不低，若大盘风险偏好下降，容易出现冲高回落。

板块轮动看板

受益方向激光雷达、锂矿、低空经济/卫星互联网、外卖平台；这是 Sparks 正收益 Top5 对 A/H 最直接的映射。
观察方向AI PC、光通信、人脸识别仍有正收益线索，但需要 CPO、消费电子和港股硬件成交确认。
压力方向软件SaaS、数据平台、存储链和高估值成长；美股负反馈提示 A/H 软件云服务先看止跌。
验证信号恒生科技能否强于恒指、南向是否净流入平台股、10Y美债是否继续上冲、油价是否维持高位。

逻辑链

宏观底色

隔夜美股小跌但油价和美债上行，A/H 高估值科技先受估值折现约束。

Sparks 输入

激光雷达、锂矿、太空和外卖成为正收益前列，资金偏向“事件+资源+硬件映射”。

A/H 映射

对应舜宇光学、赣锋锂业、美团和低空经济链，开盘必须用成交和相对强弱确认。

压力过滤

软件和存储负反馈要求回避单纯讲 AI 故事但没有价格承接的标的。

交易结论

指数大概率震荡，优先做强映射的确认交易，弱板块只等止跌信号。

风险雷达

非农若强于预期，10Y 美债继续上行会压制港股互联网和 A股成长估值。

油价若延续上涨，航空、化工中下游和消费成本链会承压，同时通胀预期扰动外资风险偏好。

Sparks 强势板块包含单股驱动成分，若 A/H 对应标的开盘不跟随，说明映射交易失效。

Major News Summary
Global
Hormuz uncertainty kept oil elevated, giving A/H energy security and shipping an event premium
The key constraint behind the overnight US pullback was the joint rise in oil and Treasury yields. Middle East and Iran-related negotiations have not produced a stable reopening expectation, so A-share oil, oilfield services, shipping, and inflation-beneficiary chains may attract defensive money, while airlines, downstream chemicals, and high-valuation growth face pressure.
Macro
US long yields rose before payrolls, limiting valuation upside for Hong Kong growth shares
Public market reports show the Dow down 0.85%, the S&P 500 down 0.18%, and the Nasdaq down 0.06% on August 6, with the US 10-year yield near 4.67%. If tonight’s payrolls are strong, Hong Kong internet and high-valuation A-share technology rebounds should first face rate pressure.
Tech
Futunn Sparks showed lidar, lithium, space, and food delivery as the strongest overnight chains
The positive top five were Lidar Technology +4.92% (AEVA +28.81%), Lithium Mining +3.99% (ALB +5.54%), Firearm Manufacturers +3.72% (CDRE +12.86%), Space +3.44% (BKSY +10.37%), and Food Delivery +3.17% (UBER +3.36%). A/H mapping focuses on smart-driving sensors, lithium resources, low-altitude economy/satellite internet, and Meituan.
Software
US software saw a high-expectation penalty, so A/H software and cloud services need stabilization first
HubSpot, Datadog, AppLovin, Figma, and Duolingo were sold on earnings, guidance, and AI-pricing concerns, showing that investors no longer reward revenue beats alone. Kingdee, Ming Yuan Cloud, and A-share software services need volume stabilization before chase buying.
Chips
Memory and semiconductors diverged, while AI PC and optical communication still had structural mapping
Sandisk and Western Digital had been pressured by guidance, showing that memory trading has moved into price and inventory verification. But Sparks still showed positive rows for AI PC, optical communication, and facial recognition, so A-share CPO, optical modules, and consumer-electronics components should be judged by relative strength rather than chased broadly.
China ADRs
China ADRs rose only slightly and breadth was weak, so platform shares need individual catalysts
Sparks showed China Concept Stocks up 0.59%, led by ZLAB +13.66%, but breadth was 16/21/0. That means Hang Seng Tech today depends more on Meituan, Alibaba, and Tencent-specific catalysts plus southbound support than on simple China ADR index beta.
Earnings
Verifiable A/H earnings results were insufficient because Futu OpenD child checks were limited
HK/SH/SZ earnings-calendar and NOTICE checks were attempted as required, but local OpenD refused 127.0.0.1:11111. No US company earnings were used to fill the A/H earnings module; today keeps only the earnings-window limitation as a risk note.
Policy
Hong Kong offshore RMB product expansion still supports financial-infrastructure themes
Recent offshore Chinese government bond futures plus RMB bond, gold, and liquidity measures in Hong Kong support exchange, brokerage, and RMB asset-allocation themes. Short term, investors still need to watch whether insurance-tax concerns keep weighing on financial weights.
Local
A-shares were steady while Hong Kong was dragged by insurers, so today needs a technology handoff
Reuters reported that mainland stocks were broadly steady in the prior session as gold miners offset technology weakness, while Hong Kong was pressured by insurers. If technology cannot take over today, the index is more likely to stay range-bound than trend higher.

Premarket View

The constructive lead is narrow but tradable: Sparks points to lidar, lithium, space/drone, and food-delivery mappings rather than a broad technology rebound. Sunny Optical, Ganfeng Lithium, Meituan, and low-altitude economy names need to prove the mapping through volume after the open.

The macro ceiling is also clear: higher oil and a US 10-year yield near 4.67% reduce the market’s tolerance for high-valuation growth. Software and memory weakness in the US means A/H cloud software and broad chip names should first be filtered by price confirmation.

The base case is a range-bound A/H open with sector rotation stronger than index beta. If Hang Seng Tech beats the Hang Seng Index and southbound money buys platform shares, the morning can lean slightly positive; otherwise defensive energy, gold, and financial-infrastructure themes should hold relative strength.

Macro Base

US stocks slipped while oil and Treasury yields rose, so high-valuation A/H technology first faces discount-rate pressure.

Sparks Input

Lidar, lithium, space, and food delivery led positive returns, pointing money toward event, resource, and hardware mappings.

A/H Mapping

The corresponding watches are Sunny Optical, Ganfeng Lithium, Meituan, and low-altitude economy names, all requiring volume and relative-strength confirmation after the open.

Pressure Filter

Software and memory negative feedback argues against buying AI stories that lack price support.

Indexes are more likely range-bound; prioritize confirmed strong mappings and wait for stabilization in weak groups.

If payrolls beat expectations, a further rise in the US 10-year yield would pressure Hong Kong internet and A-share growth valuations.

If oil keeps rising, airlines, downstream chemicals, and consumption-cost chains face pressure while inflation expectations disturb foreign risk appetite.

Some Sparks strength is single-stock driven; if mapped A/H names do not follow after the open, the mapping trade has failed.
